transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you’re here. What brings you in today?

Well, they brought me in. We were down at the fair, and... I was giving a talk. But I ended up climbing up onto the tractor right in the middle of it. I just kept jerking the controls around. I was trying to show the crowd the new pattern, you see. People were yelling at me to stop and get down, but... I just couldn't make myself stop doing it.
While that was happening, did you hear or see things that other people couldn’t?

Well, maybe not right then at the fair. But... yeah, I do hear things. Mostly when I'm out by the north pasture. Especially right around dusk, I'll hear these clear voices coming right out of the irrigation lines. They tell me exactly which rows are poisoned and which ones are blessed. And the thing is... it still happens on weeks when I'm not all fired up and running around like I was today. Even on just regular, quiet days, I still hear them talking to me from the pipes.
Have you ever had a period of several days or longer when your mood was much more elevated or irritable than usual and your energy was clearly higher than normal?

Yeah, I have. Some mornings... well, I wake up and I just feel like the whole valley is opening up for me. I'll be out there grinning at absolutely nothing, feeling like I can do it all. 

But then, on those same days, if one of the hired hands questions me on how I'm doing things, or if my wife tells me I need to slow down... I just snap. I'll go right off on them, getting mad like they've insulted the family name or something. So, yeah, it definitely gets like that for days at a time.
Have the voices ever continued for at least two weeks when you were not having a manic or depressed episode?

Yeah, they have. There was a stretch of several weeks not too long ago where things were... well, just quieter. I wasn't feeling especially energized or grand, and I wasn't feeling down, either. Just going about my normal routine. 

But even during that whole time, day after day, I still heard those irrigation lines talking to me. And I still believed the farm data reports we were getting were carrying those hidden warnings. So, yes, it definitely keeps happening even when my mood is just fine.
Have there been times when the voices or beliefs were present only when your mood was clearly elevated or depressed, and not at any other times?

Well, they definitely happen during those times, too. Like... a while back, there were a few months where I was hardly sleeping at all. I was up day and night, just pushing hard to expand the farm, feeling like I had all the energy in the world. And during that whole time, I was hearing those voices in the irrigation lines, and I was seeing all those warnings hidden in the yield maps. So they are definitely there when I'm all fired up, but like I said before, they don't *only* happen then. They stick around even when my mood is normal.
During those periods when your mood is very high and you have lots of energy, have you ever needed to be hospitalized or been unable to function safely?

Well, I haven't been put in a hospital for it, no. But... as far as functioning safely, it's gotten pretty bad. 

When I get like that, my wife and the hired hands have had to just step in and take over decisions I used to handle. It got to the point where dealing with the lenders, running the heavy equipment, just the daily operations of the farm... it just wasn't safe with me in charge. There was an incident at the county fair a while back, and after that, people really started questioning if I could even keep running the farm at all. So, yeah, it definitely stops me from functioning the way I need to.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed or down most of the day nearly every day?

No, I can't say that I have. I mean... sure, there are tough days with the work and all, but I don't really get down or depressed like that. Definitely not for weeks at a time. It's usually either I'm just feeling normal, or I get all wound up and energized like I was telling you about. But no, I haven't had any stretches where I'm just feeling sad or down every day.
Have you ever had hallucinations or fixed false beliefs for at least two weeks when you were not having a manic episode?

Yeah, I have. Like I mentioned a bit ago, there were several quieter weeks where I wasn't feeling especially energized or grand at all. Just a regular, normal mood. But... I still heard the irrigation lines talking during that whole time. And I still fully believed the farm data was carrying those hidden warnings. So, yes, it definitely happens even when I'm not all wound up.
Have you ever gone at least two weeks with the voices or fixed beliefs still present while your mood was otherwise normal?

Yeah, like I was just saying... there was a stretch of a few weeks where I felt completely normal. I wasn't wired up, wasn't feeling like I could take on the world or anything. Just quiet. But the irrigation lines were still talking to me that whole time. And I still knew for a fact that the crop data had those warnings hidden in it. So, yes, it stayed with me even when my mood was just regular.

opening_question.question: Hello, I’m glad you’re here. What brings you in today?

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient has clear manic episodes with elevated/irritable mood, increased energy, decreased sleep, grandiosity, and impaired functioning, plus persistent auditory hallucinations and fixed delusions that continue for weeks when mood is normal. This meets criteria for schizoaffective disorder, manic type, because psychotic symptoms occur both during mood episodes and independently for at least 2 weeks. Bipolar I with psychotic features is less likely because psychosis persists outside mood episodes; schizophrenia is less likely because prominent manic episodes are also present.
